_about: The only file to edit when adding a collection. Each entry becomes a chip in the layer switcher and a card under the map. The number shown is always counted from data/<id>.json; the denominator is the world total, with its as-of date. Pin shape is set per shelf so color is never the only signal. Captions marked [COPY NEEDED] are placeholders for Nancy's words.

embeds._about: Official third-party embeds in brand frames. Only past trips. Fill `id` (Strava activity id, digits) or `src` (the iframe URL Polarsteps gives under Share, Embed). Leave empty to show the placeholder frame.

items.label: A run, from Strava
items.note: [EMBED NEEDED] Paste the activity id from the Strava URL. Only an activity you have made public.

items.label: A trip, from Polarsteps
items.note: [EMBED NEEDED] In Polarsteps, open the trip, Share, Embed, copy the iframe src. Past trips only.
